blocks.text: The Zscaler and Rapid7 Deployment Guide provides instructions on how to configure Internet & SaaS (ZIA) and Unified Vulnerability Management (UVM) to work with the Rapid7 InsightIDR cloud-native security information and event management (SIEM) and extended detection and response (XDR) platform.

Rapid7's InsightIDR is a cloud-native SIEM and XDR that uses a native endpoint agent, network sensors, collectors, and APIs to monitor your network. Lightweight software-based collection technology and integration unify, correlate, and attribute data into a single picture.
Zscaler Nanolog Streaming Service (NSS) retrieves logs from the Zscaler cloud and sends them into InsightIDR.
UVM ingests, normalizes, and unifies data across enterprise security and business systems to deliver actionable insights, analytics, and operational efficiencies.
UVM offers the preconfigured Rapid7 connectors for Rapid7:

blocks.item: InsightVM Vulnerabilities: Retrieves information about the discovered vulnerabilities.
Rapid7 InsightVM Assets: Retrieves essential InsightVM asset data, such as serial number, computer ID, operating system, and IP address.
Rapid7 InsightCloudSec Assets: Retrieves essential InsightCloudSec asset data, such as serial number, computer ID, operating system, and IP address.
Rapid7 InsightCloudSec Findings: Retrieves detailed information (observations) about the risk category data of companies in your portfolio.
